data.name: Kainaat
data.gender_notes: Kainaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Samaa' meaning 'The Sky'. This beautiful name evokes the vast expanse of the night sky filled with stars and the serene tranquility of the heavens. The name Kainaat carries the meaning “The Sky” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Kainaat usually hope their child will grow to embody the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the celestial beauty and divine power of the heavens. Kainaat is a name for a child destined for greatness and blessed with a pure and enlightened soul.
data.etymology: Kainaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Sky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kainaat total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
